midi-render.note: Needs the MuseScore General SoundFont (MIT, the default sound pack of AMPLE): ample packs install soundfont

gm.note: Needs the MuseScore General SoundFont (MIT, the default sound pack of AMPLE): ample packs install soundfont

convolution.note: Needs the free impulse-responses pack (CC0, made for AMPLE): ample packs install impulse-responses

bass.note: No extra files needed: set analog-808 is a built-in sound. Name a folder of your own recordings there to play those instead.

piano.note: No extra files needed: set felt-piano is a built-in sound. Name a folder of your own recordings there to play those instead.
